def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_income = 1_500_000
    preferred_stock_par_value = 2_000_000
    preferred_dividend_rate = 0.07
    bond_par_value = 10_000_000
    bond_coupon_rate = 0.04
    tax_rate = 0.30
    common_shares = 1_000_000
    convertible_bond_shares = 300_000

    preferred_dividends = preferred_stock_par_value * preferred_dividend_rate
    after_tax_interest_saved = (
        bond_par_value * bond_coupon_rate * (1 - tax_rate)
    )

    diluted_income = (
        net_income
        - preferred_dividends
        + after_tax_interest_saved
    )
    diluted_shares = common_shares + convertible_bond_shares

    diluted_eps = diluted_income / diluted_shares

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(diluted_eps, 3)
